name: stackd
description: Stackd — upload a retail receipt, get real tokenized equity back.
//react: Next 14 is a React 18 framework. @solana/wallet-adapter-react depends on @solana-mobile/wallet-adapter-mobile, which drags in react-native and its strict react@19 peer. npm honours that peer over `overrides` and hoists react@19 to the root, where react-dom@18 then reads ReactCurrentDispatcher off React 19 internals that no longer expose it — the build dies before rendering a page. Declaring react/react-dom here forces 18.3.1 into the hoisted root position; react-native's react@19 nests under itself and never reaches the web bundle.
//devDependencies: npm hoists everything except `next` (its platform-specific @next/swc optional deps keep it nested in apps/web). eslint-config-next gets hoisted to the root and then cannot resolve next/dist/compiled/babel/eslint-parser, so `next lint` dies. Declaring next here too puts one copy at the root where both resolve.
